verdict.rationale: Bevy is a local, code-first Rust library under MIT/Apache 2.0, with no contracts or fees (bevy-docs-25, bevy-docs-21) and a stated aim that developers fully own their tools (bevy-docs-35), so projects stay as user-owned code with nothing held by a vendor. Its Scene system can save and load ECS worlds (bevy-docs-8), and it loads glTF, an open asset format (bevy-docs-38). However, the evidence never says what format saved scenes use or that any export to open formats exists; glTF support is import-only. missing for 10: documented open serialization format for saved scenes/worlds, documented export of assets/data to open interchange formats, independent hands-on corroboration of migrating projects out of Bevy.
